contexts.text: Babel, etc. in the land of Shinar () = worships, the externals of which appear holy, while the interiors are profane.
The land of Shinar = external worship in which is what is profane. Illustrated. AC 1292.
They found a valley in the land of Shinar () = that their worship became more impure and profane.
Amraphel king of Shinar, etc. () = so many kinds of apparent goods and truths.
A mantle of Shinar, etc. () = species of falsity.
Shinar () = external worship within which is what is profane.
